options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How Azahar draws the game. Vulkan is the fast one; Software is far too slow to play and is only for checking graphics bugs.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws the game's 3D at a multiple of the 3DS's resolution for a sharper picture. Higher costs speed. Screen size picks the multiple that fits the screen.

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Scales the large screen only by whole multiples of the 3DS's 240 lines: no uneven pixels, but black borders.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: How the picture is scaled up to the screen. Sharp keeps edges crisp; Smooth blends them.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Waits for the screen's refresh to stop tearing. Can add a little input lag.

notes: Verified against azahar-emu/azahar tag 2126.1.2 (9e6f523), the source pkgforge-dev/Azahar-AppImage 2126.1.2 builds with no renderer flags (get-dependencies.sh cmake line).

qt-config.ini is a QSettings IniFormat file (src/citra_qt/configuration/config.cpp:120-121). QSettings writes key=value with no spaces, booleans as true/false, enums and numbers as their integer; a '/' in a key is written as '\' in the file, so the companion of resolution_factor is the line 'resolution_factor\default=...' under [Renderer], matched literally by the ini patcher.

Every key needs its 'key\default=false' companion: ReadBasicSetting loads the built-in default instead of the key whenever key\default is true (config.cpp:133-140, 172-188), and Azahar writes key\default=(value == default) for every setting at each save (config.cpp:203-255). After a run where the player had the default, the file holds key\default=true and a patch of the key alone would be ignored. A missing companion reads as false (config.cpp:176), which is why the seed's graphics_api=2 works without one. Every choice therefore writes the key and key\default=false.

When the file is read and rewritten: QtConfig::Reload reads every value then saves the whole file back at startup (config.cpp:1485-1489); BootGame saves again after loading the game (src/citra_qt/citra_qt.cpp:1543), closeEvent saves at exit (citra_qt.cpp:4050). Values are read once at startup; the restore journal puts both lines back after exit.

Azahar's own per-game file custom/<TITLE ID>.ini (citra_qt.cpp:1515-1520, config.cpp:109-117) outranks these keys where the player set use_global=false there (config.cpp:192-199). Note: SwitchableSetting::GetValue returns the per-game value (src/common/settings.h:389-394) and the global save at boot (citra_qt.cpp:1543) writes it, so a per-game Azahar setting leaks into qt-config.ini; the restore journal undoes that for keys we override at the game level.

renderer: [Renderer] graphics_api, GraphicsAPI enum 0 Software, 1 OpenGL, 2 Vulkan (src/common/settings.h:22-26, 515-528; read at config.cpp:711). OpenGL is left out: CMakeLists.txt:100-106 turns ENABLE_OPENGL off by default on Linux aarch64 and the pkgforge build does not turn it on (the image's binary has no renderer_opengl objects); graphics_api=1 then hits 'Unknown or unsupported graphics API ... falling back' (src/video_core/video_core.cpp:28-51) and the Qt dialog greys OpenGL out (src/citra_qt/configuration/configure_graphics.cpp:43-47). The software renderer is compiled in (CMakeLists.txt:140).

resolution: [Renderer] resolution_factor u32 0..18, default 1 (settings.h:551; config.cpp:723). 0 is 'Auto (Window Size)', n is n x 400x240: labels from src/citra_qt/configuration/configure_enhancements.ui:52-142. RetroForge offers up to 5x (user, 2026-10-16: 5x already fills a 1080p panel); higher steps stay in the emulator's own menu.

integer_scale: [Renderer] use_integer_scaling bool, default false (settings.h:552; config.cpp:724); applied to the large screen (src/core/frontend/framebuffer_layout.cpp:100-110) and the whole hybrid layout (:184-185).

smoothing: [Layout] filter_mode bool, default true = linear (settings.h:625; read in the Layout group, config.cpp:545); the presentation sampler is linear or nearest from it (src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/renderer_vulkan.cpp:189, 316-321; vk_present_window.cpp:470). filter_mode is not a layout key: [Layout] layout_option and the other screen keys the dual-screen seed and the board switch use are never touched. texture_filter/texture_sampling (settings.h:117-130, 555-557) are texture enhancements, not the output filter: left for the shader phase.

vsync: [Renderer] use_vsync bool, default true off Android (settings.h:543-547; config.cpp:720); the Vulkan present window follows it (src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_present_window.cpp:108, 388-393).

Left out: aspect -- settings.h:589 has aspect_ratio but the Qt frontend never reads or writes it (absent from config.cpp; 'Default' is 'the only option on desktop', framebuffer_layout.cpp:103-106). widescreen_hack -- Azahar has none. show_fps -- the FPS is only a status-bar label (citra_qt.cpp:609-621), hidden in fullscreen (citra_qt.cpp:2724-2728), and we start it with -f: use MangoHud.
